title: L1Hypothesis (l1_hypothesis.v1)
description: Story 3.5 structured first-pass analyst verdict (FR21). AUTHORITATIVE validation source for the L1 sub-agent response contract; l1_hypothesis.yaml is the human-readable mirror and internal/decision/analyst/l1_hypothesis_schema.json is the byte-identical embedded runtime copy. schema_version is optional on the model side: the L1 runner force-stamps l1_hypothesis.v1 after validation. The referential rule that every cited event_id must exist in the input EvidencePackage is enforced programmatically by the runner (AC3); JSON Schema cannot express cross-document membership. Size bounds (hypothesis maxLength 2000, cited_evidence maxItems 50 uniqueItems, follow_up_probes maxItems 20 x maxLength 500, event_id maxLength 256, note maxLength 500) cap model-controlled output so a hostile or runaway reply cannot relay unbounded content into checkpointing, audit, or later chain prompts (Story 3.5 round-1 review).

schema_version.description: Stamped to l1_hypothesis.v1 by the runner; optional (or null) from the model.

hypothesis.description: The single most plausible hypothesis about the observed activity. Whitespace-only text is rejected programmatically by the runner.

cited_evidence.description: Events from the input package the hypothesis rests on.

event_id.description: Event.ID of a cited event; must exist in the input package (AC3, runner-enforced).

note.description: One-line relevance note for the citation.

follow_up_probes.description: Free-text follow-up probes the L1 analyst requests; consumed by later chain stages.
